newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: GOLF-13-yr-old aces hole to continue tradition.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-13-yr-old aces hole to continue tradition.

text.p: HASTINGS, Jan 7 - Thirteen-year-old Aucklander Douglas Drury completed what has become a family tradition when he holed in one on the Pupuke golf course on Auckland's North Shore last month.
The New Zealand Press Association reports he was joining his grandfather, his father and his older brother in achieving the rare golfing feat.
Douglas's father Graham, now 48, was also 13 when he began the tradition as a schoolboy at Wellington College playing on the Berhampore course.
Graham's father, John, got into the act in 1972 when he aced the fourth hole at Bridge Pa, Hastings.
The third of the family's holes-in-one came in 1995 when Graham's eldest son Hamish was playing on an Australian course while on holiday.
While father and son holes-in-one have been recorded before, the Drury family's achievement is probably unique, considering many golfers go through their entire careers without scoring a hole in one.
